21531-woodwork-joints.title: Woodwork Joints
21531-woodwork-joints.creator: Unknown
21531-woodwork-joints.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. not professing to be a graded course of "educational woodwork," the Volume is one which Handicraft Instructors will find of the greatest value in conducting woodwork classes. No book hitherto published contains such a variety of illustrations of joints, almost all of which will form suitable exercises of practical educational importance in a woodworking course.

arxiv-2102-06655.title: Responsibility and verification: Importance value in temporal logics Thanks: This work was funded by DFG grant 389792660 as part of TRR 248 (see https://perspicuous-computing.science ), the Cluster of Excellence EXC 2050/1 (CeTI, project ID 390696704, as part of Germany’s Excellence Strategy), DFG-p
arxiv-2102-06655.creator: Corto Mascle 1 , Christel Baier 2 , Florian Funke 2 , Simon Jantsch 2 , Stefan Kiefer 3
arxiv-2102-06655.description: Abstract We aim at measuring the influence of the nondeterministic choices of a part of a system on its ability to satisfy a specification. For this purpose, we apply the concept of Shapley values to verification as a means to evaluate how important a part of a system is.

arxiv-2209-14278.title: Quantum Phase Processing and its Applications in Estimating Phase and Entropies
arxiv-2209-14278.creator: Youle Wang, Lei Zhang, Zhan Yu, Xin Wang
arxiv-2209-14278.description: Abstract Quantum computing can provide speedups in solving many problems as the evolution of a quantum system is described by a unitary operator in an exponentially large Hilbert space. Such unitary operators change the phase of their eigenstates and make quantum algorithms fundamentally different from their classical counterparts.

arxiv-2311-07311.title: Do large language models and humans have similar behaviors in causal inference with script knowledge?
arxiv-2311-07311.creator: Xudong Hong, Margarita Ryzhova, Daniel Adrian Biondi, Vera Demberg, [0.8ex] Dept. of Computer Science, Saarland University
arxiv-2311-07311.description: Abstract Recently, large pre-trained language models (LLMs) have demonstrated superior language understanding abilities, including zero-shot causal reasoning. However, it is unclear to what extent their capabilities are similar to human ones. We here study the processing of an event B B in a script-based story, which causally depends on a previous event A A .

arxiv-2509-17038.title: Emergent Ising symmetry and supercritical fluids
arxiv-2509-17038.creator: Hong-Ming Cui
arxiv-2509-17038.description: Abstract The symmetry of Ising model questions any single crossover scenario for supercritical fluids. In this work, we firstly study a pair of thermodynamic crossovers L^{\pm} analytically for the Van der Waals class fluids. We uncover an emergent Z_{2} symmetry in addition to the universal scalings in the scaling regime for this class fluids.

arxiv-2512-09785.title: Water versus land on temperate rocky planets
arxiv-2512-09785.creator: Claire Marie Guimond, Tilman Spohn, Svetlana Berdyugina, Paul K. Byrne, Nicolas Coltice, Donald M. Glaser, Manasvi Lingam, Charles H. Lineweaver, Peter A. Cawood
arxiv-2512-09785.description: Abstract Water and land surfaces on a planet interact in particular ways with gases in the atmosphere and with radiation from the star. These interactions define the environments that prevail on the planet, some of which may be more amenable to prebiotic chemistry, some to the evolution of more complex life.

arxiv-2601-22947.title: Relaxing Positional Alignment in Masked Diffusion Language Models
arxiv-2601-22947.creator: Mengyu Ye, Ryosuke Takahashi, Keito Kudo, Jun Suzuki
arxiv-2601-22947.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Mengyu Ye, Ryosuke Takahashi, Keito Kudo, Jun Suzuki. Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to dominant autoregressive approaches. Although they achieve competitive performance on several tasks, a substantial gap remains in open-ended text generation. We hypothesize that one cause of this gap is that strict positional prediction makes MDLM decoding highly sensitive to token misalignment, and we show through controlled interventions that a one-position shift can severely disrupt semantics.

britannica-1911-montegut-jean-baptiste-j.description: Article 'Montégut, Jean Baptiste Joseph Émile' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. French critic, was born at Limoges on the 14th of June 1825. He began to write for the Revue des deux mondes in 1847, contributing between 1851 and 1857 a series of articles on the English and American novel, and in 1857 he became chief literary critic of the review. Émile Montégut translated Essais de philosophies américaine (1850) from Emerson; Révolution de 1688 (2 vols.

plos-pone-0008597.creator: Oliver Niehuis, Joshua D. Gibson, Michael S. Rosenberg et al.

Previous research explored recombination in the honeybee, a eusocial hymenopteran with an exceptionally high genome-wide recombination rate. A comparable s

pmc-10492370.title: Computational biology and in vitro studies for anticipating cancer-related molecular targets of sweet wormwood (Artemisia annua)
pmc-10492370.creator: Hend Dawood, Ismail Celik, Reham S. Ibrahim
pmc-10492370.description: BackgroundCancer is one of the leading causes of death worldwide. Recently, it was shown that many natural extracts have positive effects against cancer, compared with chemotherapy or recent hormonal treatments. A. annua is an annual medicinal herb used in the traditional Chinese medicine. It has also been shown to inhibit the proliferation of various cancer cell lines.

pmc-10693601.title: Assembly mechanism of the inflammasome sensor AIM2 revealed by single molecule analysis
pmc-10693601.creator: Meenakshi Sharma, Eva de Alba
pmc-10693601.description: Pathogenic dsDNA prompts AIM2 assembly leading to the formation of the inflammasome, a multimeric complex that triggers the inflammatory response. The recognition of foreign dsDNA involves AIM2 self-assembly concomitant with dsDNA binding. However, we lack mechanistic and kinetic information on the formation and propagation of the assembly, which can shed light on innate immunity’s time response and specificity.

pmc-11506849.title: Accelerated Life Testing of Biodegradable Starch Films with Nanoclay Using the Elongation Level as a Stressor
pmc-11506849.creator: Theofilos Frangopoulos, Apostolos Ketesidis, Anna Marinopoulou, Athanasios Goulas, Dimitrios Petridis, Vassilis Karageorgiou, Luís Marangoni Júnior
pmc-11506849.description: An attempt was made to evaluate the elongation level as a stressor on biodegradable starch films reinforced with nanoclay using a simple linear model. A total of 120 film units were subjected to increasing elongation levels and the exact break time of the failed units was monitored.

pmc-11673677.title: Novel Antimicrobial and Antitumor Agents Bearing Pyridine-1,2,4-triazole-3-thione-hydrazone Scaffold: Synthesis, Biological Evaluation, and Molecular Docking Investigation
pmc-11673677.creator: Aida Šermukšnytė, Maryna Stasevych, Olena Komarovska-Porokhnyavets, Viktor Zvarych, Eglė Jakubauskienė, Kristina Kantminienė, Ingrida Tumosienė
pmc-11673677.description: A series of target 4-substituted-5-(2-(pyridine-2-ylamino)ethyl)-2,4-dihydro-3H-1,2,4-triazole-3-thiones and their chloro analogs 7–21 were synthesized in a reaction of the selected aldehydes with the corresponding 4-amino-1,2,4-triazole-3-thiones 5 and 6, which were obtained from 3-(pyridin-2-ylamino)propanoic acid (3) or 3-((5-chloropyridin-2-yl)amino)propanoic acid (4), respectively, with thioacetohydrazide.

pmc-12530883.title: Apoptotic bodies derived from hypoxic bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells reverse LPS-induced apoptosis delay in neutrophils
pmc-12530883.creator: Yifan Zhao, Xiaoyan Li, Yitong Liu, Jiling Qiu, Siyan Liu, Juan Du, Zhenhua Luo, Junji Xu, Yi Liu
pmc-12530883.description: Immune system disorders underlie numerous chronic inflammatory diseases. Functional status and normal apoptosis of neutrophils are of great significance in the regulation and outcome of inflammation. Excessive activation and delayed apoptosis of neutrophils can lead to additional tissue damage, which may be an important cause of delayed disease recovery.

pmc-12606788.title: Diagnostic criteria for HPV infection classification: a comment on Wen et al.
pmc-12606788.creator: Elian Analí Camero-Ortiz, Silvia Karen Delgado-García, Guido Bendezu-Quispe, Gustavo A. Grandez-Castillo
pmc-12606788.description: BackgroundWe read with great interest Wen et al.‘s article on HPV infection in Huizhou men, commending this pioneering research as the first systematic analysis of HPV epidemiology in the region. The findings, including a 30.53% positivity rate and prevalent genotypes like HPV6, HPV52, HPV11, and HPV16, offer valuable insights for developing effective prevention strategies.

pmc-12738078.title: Identifying and Characterizing Lipid-Binding Cavities in Lipid Transfer Proteins With CG-MD Simulations
pmc-12738078.creator: Daniel Álvarez, Stefano Vanni, Sriraksha Srinivasan
pmc-12738078.description: Understanding how lipids interact with lipid transfer proteins (LTPs) is essential for uncovering their molecular mechanisms. Yet, many available LTP structures, particularly those thought to function as membrane bridges, lack detailed information on where their native lipid ligands are located.

pmc-13176659.title: Applying traditional K-foods to official development assistance programs for micronutrient deficiency nutrition support
pmc-13176659.creator: Sohye Cho, Jung Min Cho
pmc-13176659.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Micronutrient deficiencies are a major public health concern in low- and middle-income countries, where conventional supplementation and fortification programs are often limited by low bioavailability, fragile supply chains, cultural resistance, and poor long-term adherence. This research note proposes a food-based alternative model that leverages selected traditional Korean foods (K-foods)—gim (dried seaweed), kimchi (fermented vegetables), and cheonggukjang (fermented soybean paste)—as culturally adaptable and nutritionally dense components of official development assistance nutrition strategies.

pmc-13279192.title: Impaired cortical actin dynamics via lanosterol-dependent HMG-CoA reductase downregulation mediates IFN-α-induced mast cell stabilization
pmc-13279192.creator: Rema Naskar, Liu Ye, Sanu Karan, Kwan Soo Hong, Youngil Yeom, Inkyu Hwang
pmc-13279192.description: Independent studies have reported that interferon-β induces CYP51A1 downregulation leading to lanosterol (LAN) accumulation; that LAN triggers HMG-CoA reductase (HMGCR) downregulation; and that statin-mediated HMGCR inhibition suppresses mast cell activation. Building on these findings, we investigated whether the known mast cell–stabilizing effect of IFN-α/β is driven by this LAN-induced HMGCR downregulation.

pmc-13673055.title: Frontal lead in preterm functional brain maturation
pmc-13673055.creator: Johannes Mader, Manfred Hartmann, Katrin Klebermass-Schrehof, Tobias Werther, Anastasia Dressler, Johannes Koren, Gregor Kasprian, Victor Schmidbauer, Renate Fuiko, Lisa Oberdorfer, Nadine Pointner, Angelika Berger, Tilmann Kluge, Vito Giordano
pmc-13673055.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Understanding how brain maturation unfolds in preterm neonates is critical for both neuroscience and clinical care. Structural MRI suggests that the frontal cortex develop late, yet EEG offers a direct window into functional activity that follows a different trajectory. We analysed 211 EEG recordings from 62 preterm neonates (25–40 weeks postmenstrual age, PMA) using convolutional neural networks trained on single channels to estimate functional brain age (FBA).

(a) The Postal Service is authorized to provide for the safe and expeditious transportation of mail by aircraft.
